rules.rule: The description states when to use the skill
The skill directory name is the lowercase kebab-case skill ID
Tests focus on a single public method at a time

assertions.value: single public method at a time

rules.rule: A parameterized test is preferred when several tests exercise the same method with different data sets or expected results

assertions.value: same method\s+(with|using) different input data sets

rules.rule: The common GIVEN / WHEN / THEN structure is mutualized into a single parameterized test
JUnit 5 @ParameterizedTest with @MethodSource, @CsvSource, or @ValueSource is used, chosen per data shape
The project's existing testing framework and conventions are followed
Test data is kept separate from test execution logic when that improves readability

assertions.value: Keep test data separate from test execution logic

rules.rule: Every data set is a meaningful test case with an explicit expected outcome

assertions.value: meaningful test case with an explicit expected outcome

rules.rule: Test methods that differ only in input values or expected results are not duplicated

assertions.value: differ only in their input values or expected results

rules.rule: Unrelated behaviors are never forced into one parameterized test; materially different setup, execution, or assertions stay separate

assertions.value: Do not force unrelated behaviors into a single parameterized test

rules.rule: Readability and diagnostic value of individual test cases are preserved

assertions.value: readability and diagnostic value of individual test cases

rules.rule: Every parameterized test has an explicit display name identifying both the test case and the data set

assertions.value: identif(y|ies) both the \*\*test case\*\* and the \*\*data set\*\*

rules.rule: Display names never rely solely on generated defaults or numeric indexes; Named arguments or a test-case description are used

assertions.value: Do not rely solely on generated default display names or numeric indexes

rules.rule: Display names are neither ambiguous, excessively verbose, nor dependent on object memory addresses

assertions.value: ambiguous, excessively verbose, or dependent on object memory addresses

rules.rule: Failure reports clearly identify which scenario and data set failed

assertions.value: failure reports clearly identify which scenario and data set failed

rules.rule: The customerLookupCases reference example and its expected display names are included

assertions.value: `existing customer with id 1 returns the customer`

rules.rule: General unit-test conventions still apply and are owned by the unit-test skill, not duplicated here
The definition of done covers mutualization, data-set coverage, display names, FIRST, Mockito verification, and passing tests

assertions.value: Repeated test logic is mutualized where appropriate

rules.rule: The Rules table covers exactly the spec rule IDs
A README documents purpose, when to use, how to run, dependency graph, and workflow graph
Duplicated tests differing only in data are merged into one parameterized test whose invocations have explicit scenario-and-data display names
Tests of the same method with materially different setup or assertions are kept separate instead of being forced into one parameterized test
